assumptions: Chemical equilibrium in the chamber and at the throat (shifting), infinite-area combustor, adiabatic, ideal gases (NASA RP-1311 Part I).
Gas-phase products only: 28 species from the excerpt; a condensed phase that would be stable is refused, not modelled.
Reactant enthalpies at the temperatures thermo.inp assigns (cryogens at their listed temperature, storables at 298.15 K).
Frames and time scales: none (a thermochemical state has no position or epoch).
Sample: the inputs are an arbitrary illustration, not a claim about any engine.
